preview.label: Heard

preview.label: Decide
preview.headline: The model is told at a Turn boundary, so A gets a proper goodbye

preview.headline: B gets a new Episode, a new target and a clean context

fixtures.label: A keeps context, then B starts clean

fixtures.label: B calls, then leaves · a stale cue opens no Episode
fixtures.situation: A queued cue goes stale before its turn: drop it on the new evidence rather than acting on the old.
